Record Class Personal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.jsonschema.generator.ref.Personal
Record Components:
givenName - Given name. It can be multiple words for compound names
familyName - Family name. Depending on cultures, this field can be very different
nativeLanguage - First learned language. Or preferred language if you had many
Avatar - Avatar. Image used to represent you without being an actual photo
Nationalities - Set of nationalities. If none is supplied, the birth of country is used
public record Personal(@NotNull String givenName, @NotNull String familyName, @Pattern(regexp="[a-z]{2}") @NotNull String nativeLanguage, Personal.Pronoun Pronoun, Personal.Gender Gender, String Birth, @Pattern(regexp="[A-Z]{2}") String birthCountry, String Alias, String Photo, String Avatar, Set<@Pattern(regexp="[A-Z]{2}") String> Nationalities, List<Disability> Disabilities, List<DrivingLicense> drivingLicenses, boolean ownVehicle, List<IdDocument> Ids) extends Record

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
